title: Entrepreneurial Environment and Growth
learning_outcome: Describe entrepreneurial environment and growth factors.

alignment.course_outcome: CO1 - Discuss the fundamentals of entrepreneurship

illustration.subject: A venture ecosystem map connecting a startup with customers, university laboratory, incubator, bank, investor, supplier, public agency and talent network
illustration.composition: Radial network map with a strong central venture and visibly different node types
illustration.style: Layered systems-map illustration with hand-drawn connectors and subtle landscape context

case: Case connection: The National Startup Awards 2023 resource-pack snapshot can be used qualitatively to discuss district diffusion, women-led ventures, policy simplification and sectoral innovation without relying on undated statistics.
misconception: Common mistake: Treating growth as revenue increase alone or assuming that more ecosystem organisations automatically remove venture bottlenecks.
application: Draw a five-node ecosystem for a campus venture and identify the relationship that needs evidence before growth.
